svg.title: Lantern Vale — simpler building style prototype
svg.desc: Current level-two cottage, bakery and woodcutter compared with proposed broad, unoutlined colour shapes. Both sides use the same existing game workers, trees and rocks. Enlarged scenes above, 46-pixel-tile reference views below. Proposed artwork only.
svg.text: Make the buildings speak the landscape’s language.
Broad colour faces • fewer lines • chunky useful props • the same workers and scenery on both sides
One clear door, two warm windows, broad timber supports.
Keep the chimney, oven and bread counter; drop the surface seams.
Keep the open shelter, axe and logs; use fewer, larger shapes.
46 px tile reference at 100% image size. Enlarged comparisons above are 2.45×. Display scaling may resize this sheet.
Prototype only. Preserve recognizable silhouettes and upgrades; review other tiers and compact sites before a game-wide change.
